picks.thesis: Bear call spread on QQQ with short call delta 0.3186 sits near the middle of the 0.25‑0.35 band and offers a strong credit‑to‑width of 0.32 (credit 0.32 for a 1‑point width). With 1 day to expiration and IV 0.1765, it captures premium quickly while keeping risk limited to the 1‑point spread.

Bear call spread on SPY has short call delta 0.2666, a solid credit‑to‑width of 0.25 (credit 0.25 for a 1‑point width), and 1 day DTE. IV 0.1294 is modest, making the premium attractive relative to the limited risk of the 1‑point spread.
